name: Wyoming
agency: Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT), Driver Services

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours behind the wheel, including 10 at night, certified by a parent or guardian
teen.holdPermit: 10 days on the learner's permit before the intermediate permit at 16; intermediate permit held 6 months or until 17
teen.nightLimit: Intermediate permit: drive only 5 a.m. to 11 p.m.; exceptions for work, school, sports, religious activities with a signed exception form; medical emergency needs no form
teen.passengerLimit: Intermediate permit: no more than one passenger under 18 who is not immediate family, unless a licensed adult 18+ is in the front seat (WYDOT; 2002 bill text said under 21)
teen.phone: Texting while driving banned (W.S. 31-5-237 per WYDOT safety plan); no statewide handheld call ban, some cities have one

notes: Handbook URL is the WYDOT Driver Manuals page (2021 Class C manual listed there); direct PDF URL not confirmed. No Spanish manual found.
Knowledge test: commercial sites say 25 questions, 20 correct (80 percent); an older source said 76 percent. Not confirmed officially, so exam fields are null.
Speed (WYDOT 2016 speed booklet): 80 mph interstates, 70 paved roads, 55 unpaved, 30 urban, 20 signed school zones. Speeding in school or construction zones goes on the record.
Move-over law: only introduced bills found (2017 HB0064, 2018 HB0036); status not confirmed, not used in questions.
School bus cameras: 2019 SF0080, owner fine $195 when driver unknown; not used in questions.
Adult BAC 0.08 not checked in this budget; left null.
